author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring comic/illustration team
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Looking for people who are serious, consistent, and can work with a team. Send CV & portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until all positions are filled.

author: attenboroughac
title: Paid mural painter for exhibition wall
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Open to all including students and recent graduates. Must follow reference images of floral patterns and leaves, be comfortable using acrylic paints, complete the mural in the given time frame. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration: 3 days, 28–30 September 2026. Location: Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send short bio explaining suitability, portfolio and examples, or website and Instagram to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
